info.title: v2.video.get_video_performance_list
info.description: Get specific performance data for individual post Shopee Video. There is at least a one-day delay.

get.description: Get specific performance data for individual post Shopee Video. There is at least a one-day delay.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end_date format should be "YYYY-MM-DD". - For Day, Last7d, Last15d, and Last30d, the end_date must before current day. - For Week, the end_date must be Sunday and must be less than or equal to the current week. - For Month, the end_date must be the end of the month and must be less than or equal to the current month.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Use this field to specify which field to use to sort the returned list. Available values: Views Likes Comments AvgViewsDuration

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: The start index of request. Starting from 1.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The number of video returned by this request. Max is 20.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: Period Type. Applicable values: Day Week Month Last7d Last15d Last30d Note: The end date must align with the Period Type.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by(depends on different APIs) partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, user_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Use this field to specify whether the returned list is sorted in ascending or descending order_by. Available values: asc desc

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a user.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/video/get_video_performance_list?access_token=access_token&caption=-&end_date=2025-10-30&order_by=Likes&page_no=1&page_size=10&partner_id=partner_id&period_type=Last7d&sign=sign&sort=desc&timestamp=timestamp&user_id=user_id',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
